---

### Hints that keep this alive

- **"This week we"** is past tense and factual: "read ch. 6–7; made timeline
  cards," not "worked on history."
- **Evidence** = pointer to a file you actually saved in `weeks/week-NN/`,
  or "photo taken [date]," or "in Saxon grade book p. 14." A pointer is
  enough on Sunday night; save the actual file by Wednesday.
- **Miss a week?** Write "week skipped: illness" and move on. Honest gaps
  read as real life; silent gaps read as records problems.
- **Log lines feed the portfolio:** quarterly, paste whole weeks into the
  portfolio-summaries prompt
  ([prompts/portfolio-summaries.md](../prompts/portfolio-summaries.md)).
